_about: Data for scripts/check-docs.mjs. reference: the chapter numbers and appendix letters the reference must hold (D6). ratchet: exact counts over docs/reference (D8); when one falls, lower it to the number the check prints, never raise it. They were set at the split to what docs/reference measured (the single-file manual before it measured 105 release paragraphs, 52 file:line citations and 352 section signs; the release log and the audits took the rest to docs/history, the option table to docs/guide). history: sha256 of each frozen file in docs/history (D9). nameAllowlist: backticked UPPER_SNAKE names the operator pages may use that are not option keys (D4); each must occur as a string literal in server/src (docsLayout.test.ts).
